findings.title: Environment lookup issues extra queries per issue and swallows errors
findings.body: get_environment_info calls issue.get_recommended_event() and get_environment() for every issue while the comment is built. This adds a Snuba/nodestore query per issue, up to 5 issues per PR comment. The broad `except Exception` only logs at info level, so failures are hidden. The error object is also placed in `extra`, which may not serialize cleanly.

findings.title: Comment template drops the culprit and adds blank lines
findings.body: MERGED_PR_SINGLE_ISSUE_TEMPLATE ends with `\n`, and the callers join items with `\n`. The result is blank lines between bullets and a trailing blank line. The culprit/subtitle that was shown before is also removed. That is a user-visible format change, and the formatting is awkward.

findings.title: Autofix automation default changed from 'low' to 'off'
findings.body: The default for autofix automation tuning changed from 'low' to 'off'. Projects that never set the option will silently stop receiving automated autofix runs. The PR description gives no rationale for this behavior change, and the PR is otherwise unrelated to the change.

findings.title: Editing already-applied historical migrations
findings.body: The migration body is replaced with a no-op, and the comment claims it was never run. If it did run in any environment, the data conversion is now inconsistent with the history. The migration test file for 0917 was also deleted, and the replacement migration 0921 is not shown in this PR.

findings.title: Age/timestamp validation uses truthiness
findings.body: validate_timestamp and validate_age check `initial_data.get(...)` for truthiness. A value of 0 (for example `age: 0`) is treated as absent, so a report with both fields can pass validation. Neither field is required, so a report with neither also passes.

findings.title: Error events matched to IDs by zip over dict values
findings.body: `zip(error_ids, events.values())` assumes get_multi returns results in the same order as error_ids. Dict order does not guarantee that, and missing nodes may be omitted from the result. Events can therefore be paired with the wrong IDs. Keys should be looked up explicitly by node_id.

findings.title: Shared error list is sorted in place, and paginated callbacks can reuse it
findings.body: get_request_data sorts error_events in place, mutating the shared list. Separate error-event log lines are emitted on every page of segments, because the same error_events are passed to every on_results call.

findings.title: Analytics recorded before the feature flag check
findings.body: analytics.record runs before the feature-flag check, so events are emitted even for orgs where the endpoint returns 404. It also uses request.user.id, which can be None for token auth. Recording after the check would be more accurate.

findings.title: Feature-flagged table renders empty data
findings.body: When 'use-table-widget-visualization' is on, TableWidgetVisualization is rendered with columns=[] and empty data, ignoring result.data and result.meta. Enabling the flag shows blank tables on dashboards.

findings.title: Analytics event key renamed
findings.body: trackAnalytics now uses 'replay.view-html' instead of 'replay.view_html'. Any dashboards or consumers keyed on the old event name will lose data. The key does match the event map entry.
